result.instructions: Tools for Plain, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me all urgent support threads that are still open."; "Which threads are assigned to me, and what is the oldest one?"; "Find the customer with the email address jane@example.com and show their open threads.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Plain data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run plain_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run plain_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run plain_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. plain_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: plain_get_workspace
tools.title: Get workspace
tools.description: Get the Plain workspace this API key belongs to: id, name, public name and domain names. No arguments. Plain GraphQL query: myWorkspace.

tools.name: plain_list_threads
tools.title: List threads
tools.description: List support threads (conversations) with optional filters: statuses (TODO, SNOOZED, DONE), priorities (0 urgent to 3 low), customer ids, assignee user ids, label type ids, and whether a thread is assigned. Optional sort by CREATED_AT, STATUS_CHANGED_AT, PRIORITY, LAST_INBOUND_MESSAGE_AT or CLOSEST_TO_BREACH_SLA. Paginate with `after` (endCursor). Plain GraphQL query: threads.

tools.name: plain_get_thread
tools.title: Get thread
tools.description: Get one support thread by its id: title, preview, status, priority, assignee, customer and labels. Plain GraphQL query: thread.

tools.name: plain_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer (the person who writes to support) by `customerId` OR by `email` (give exactly one): name, email, external id and dates. Plain GraphQL query: customer or customerByEmail.

tools.name: plain_list_label_types
tools.title: List label types
tools.description: List the active (not archived) label types of the workspace: id, name, description and color. Use the ids with plain_add_labels and plain_list_threads. Plain GraphQL query: labelTypes.

tools.name: plain_list_users
tools.title: List assignable users
tools.description: List the workspace users who can be assigned to threads: id, full name, public name, email and status. Use the ids with plain_assign_thread. Plain GraphQL query: users.

tools.name: plain_add_note
tools.title: Add internal note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a customer, optionally on one thread. Notes stay with the team and never reach the customer. Plain GraphQL mutation: createNote.

tools.name: plain_add_labels
tools.title: Add labels to thread
tools.description: Add one or more label types to a thread. Get label type ids from plain_list_label_types. Plain GraphQL mutation: addLabels.

tools.name: plain_remove_labels
tools.title: Remove labels from thread
tools.description: Remove labels from threads by label id (the id of the label on the thread, from plain_get_thread, not the label type id). Plain GraphQL mutation: removeLabels.

tools.name: plain_assign_thread
tools.title: Assign thread
tools.description: Assign a thread to a workspace user. Replaces the current assignee. Get user ids from plain_list_users. Plain GraphQL mutation: assignThread.

tools.name: plain_unassign_thread
tools.title: Unassign thread
tools.description: Remove the assignee from a thread. Plain GraphQL mutation: unassignThread.

tools.name: plain_set_thread_priority
tools.title: Set thread priority
tools.description: Set the priority of a thread: 0 = Urgent, 1 = High, 2 = Normal, 3 = Low. Plain GraphQL mutation: changeThreadPriority.

tools.name: plain_mark_thread_done
tools.title: Mark thread done
tools.description: Mark a thread as DONE (closed). Plain GraphQL mutation: markThreadAsDone.

tools.name: plain_reopen_thread
tools.title: Reopen thread (mark todo)
tools.description: Move a thread back to TODO (open). Plain GraphQL mutation: markThreadAsTodo.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Plain
prompts.description: What you can do with Plain here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: triage_open_urgent_threads
prompts.title: Triage open urgent threads
prompts.description: List open threads by priority, status or assignee, then read one thread with its customer and labels.

prompts.name: look_up_a_customer_and_their_threads
prompts.title: Look up a customer and their threads
prompts.description: Find a customer by email address or customer id, then list the threads that belong to that customer.

prompts.name: add_an_internal_note
prompts.title: Add an internal note
prompts.description: Add an internal note to a customer, optionally on one thread. The customer never sees the note.

prompts.name: assign_a_thread_and_set_its_priority
prompts.title: Assign a thread and set its priority
prompts.description: List the users who can be assigned, then assign a thread to one of them and set its priority.

prompts.name: label_and_close_a_resolved_thread
prompts.title: Label and close a resolved thread
prompts.description: List the label types, add the right labels to a thread, then mark the thread done.
